author: NukemNintendo
quote:
Never mind all of the bugs and really bad drops and frame rate this game has. Even without those things, it is still a very boring and uninspiring game that spends a great deal of time forcing me to watch it play itself. 

I understand most games might start off slow and build up to the action but this game just never gets going. 

If you are expecting to have a great time playing a crime simulation game like previous GTA games, I hope you are ready for a very boring life Sim instead. 

While life simulators can be fun, this game doesn't actually reward you for doing the boring chores and couch conversations you spend most of your time doing. 

I was also very disappointed to see how empty the beaches were despite singing hundreds of people walking around the beach in the trailers for this game. 

Instead it is just a very empty and soulless Beach. 

The very last thing that was disappointing was the very bland relationship between Jason and Lucia. The chemistry between them just seems very shoehorned and lacks any bit of passion and authenticity to it. There just isn't any real rawness to their relationship. 

I was at the very least hoping this would be a really intriguing Bonnie and Clyde story but it's just one boring life Sim.

author: NukemNintendo
quote:
After 25 plus years, I finally understand why The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time is a masterpiece and regarded as the greatest video game ever made. 

I tried playing the original on the N64 at a very young age when I was still too young to even read and understand what was going on. 

This remake has not only fixed the issues and setbacks of the original masterpiece on the N64 but it also breathes so much life into the game and story. 

The powerful music, emotional events, lively characters, and intricate level designs, the great sense of exploration, and beautiful art style of the game makes me invest so many hours of my life into it. 

They're very few games that **** me in like this and it is rare for a single player game too captivate my imagination. 

I love so much of the characters and every moment in this game is impactful big or small. 

The game is masterfully designed to make you feel rewarded when you finally figure out how to progress to the next event. 

It's definitely a game that does not hold your hand but it also provides you with enough clues to get creative and figure out how to advance in a story. 

This is easily the greatest video game that has ever been made and it even inspires me to go back and play the original. 

But make no mistake about it, this is easily better than the original and is far more enhanced in every way. 

There is not a single moment in this game that had me frustrated or uninterested. Definitely the best 30 hours I have spent on a game!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: NukemNintendo
quote:
Death stranding 2 is yet another boring cinematic experience that has no business calling itself a video game. 

This pretentious and boring piece of garbage will waste your time by having you deliver objects from one area on a map to another. After this, you will get a very long and drawn out cutscene of some mediocre characters that try really hard to be larger than life but are just rip offs of other popular western characters.

The gameplay is absolute trash and the story is just pretentious like the first game. This is truly one of the most boring games you can ever play. The only types of people who might pretend to enjoy this are moviegoers and people who just binge watch Netflix or Hulu. 

Even if this game was free, do not waste your time with it. That is time you will regret wasting.

author: NukemNintendo
quote:
This game feels like a very boring DLC expansion to the first game. It doesn't feel like a very long and compelling story and on top of that, the gameplay is absolute garbage. 

This is just another cinematic experience more so than an actual video game. The voice acting itself is pretty cheap and NPC sounding. Almost feels like listening to dialogue from an elder scrolls game but worse somehow. 

Then there are the stupid character choices and motivations. You finally end up killing one of the perpetrators responsible for the death of the protagonist family but for some stupid reason she decides to spare the life of some wicked female who was also involved. 

I absolutely hate stupid games that do this. They don't give you the option to exact revenge on certain characters. It is a slap in the face and it makes this boring video game all the more worse!

author: NukemNintendo
quote:
Kirby Air Riders is that rare game that reminds you why you fell in love with gaming in the first place. It’s fast, creative, endlessly replayable, and packed with so many different things to do that it feels like a complete gaming playground.

Every time I tell myself “just one more round,” I end up playing five or six more. The game flows so smoothly from one match to the next that it’s easy to lose track of time. It captures that old-school arcade energy; the kind that makes every race, battle, and challenge feel instantly rewarding.

The controls are deceptively simple but surprisingly deep. It only takes a short while to get used to how the machines handle, but once it clicks, it’s incredibly satisfying. There’s real skill involved, and mastering each mode feels like learning a new sport. 

Speaking of modes, the variety here is amazing: intense racing, top-down challenges, all-out battle arenas, boss fights, and even a full adventure mode that ties everything together. The City Trial alone could be its own game; that five-minute scramble across a floating city before the final showdown is pure adrenaline. There’s also a great sense of progression. You’re constantly unlocking new vehicles, tracks, customization parts, characters, and music.

It feels like there’s always something new to chase, which keeps you hooked for hours at a time. It’s fun solo, it’s even better with friends, and it’s accessible enough for anyone to pick up and play. 

Kirby Air Riders nails the three things that matter most in any video ****, content, and replayability; and it does so with style. This isn’t just the best Kirby game, it’s one of the best games Nintendo has made in years. 

It’s pure, unfiltered fun from start to finish, and easily earns a perfect 10 out of 10 in my book.

author: NukemNintendo
quote:
This is a huge upgrade from Hyrule Warriors: age of calamity! 

The game is beautiful and the gameplay is fast, solid, and a lot of fun! I really enjoy the concept of choosing which regions and camps to travel to for battle. The story is very compelling so far and keeps me engaged. 

In addition to the usual Warriors gameplay of slashing through thousands of enemy troops, there is even an awesome Star Fox like mode where you take to the sky to shoot missiles, launch bombs, and fire away at enemies on the ground or in the air! 

The game has a really good roster of characters to choose from and play as. I definitely recommend this game to warrior fans and fans of The Legend of Zelda!

author: NukemNintendo
quote:
A love letter to all Donkey Kong fans and a revolution to the 3D platforming adventure genre; Donkey Kong Bananza has recaptured the magic and nostalgia that so many of us old school gamers have lost.

The game doesn't lazily rely on nostalgia, it amplifies it to perfection with its addictive fight mechanics and destructible world.

The story seems simple on the surface but the lore gets deeper the further you go with a glorious and shocking twist near the end.

There are so many games and challenges to discover when punching your way through the earth and many ability to unlock on a skill tree.

This is the perfect and greatest single player game to pick up. It combines the best of so many different genres such as: Beat Em Up, Platforming, Adventure, and world exploration!
